defect.description: When no token book exists at or after a requested markout horizon, the legacy helper returns the final snapshot even if that snapshot is before the horizon. This violates the probe's stated censoring contract and can label a censored 60s/300s markout as observed.
defect.affected_evidence: historical forward-maker horizon markouts produced before the strict wrapper; ex-reward realized PnL and fill counts are not changed by this defect
defect.repair: run the existing FIFO replay through a strict horizon wrapper that returns null unless a snapshot at or after the exact horizon exists, and add a 45-second executable-bid markout alongside 60s and 300s

interpretation: The unconditional improve1 policy remains rejected even if all pre-fix 300s markout evidence is discarded: all 10 observed fills are one-sided, total ex-reward PnL is materially negative, and the moving-block bootstrap upper confidence bound remains below zero. The 300s markout statistic itself is not relied upon until regenerated under strict horizon censoring.
next_gate: fresh chronological strict-probe sessions with FIFO fills and executable-bid 45s/60s/300s markouts; inside-spread remains conditional on positive incremental fill-conditioned EV and the 0.5 bp residual edge floor
